questions.explanation: 'De basisschool' is primary school, for children roughly aged 4 to 12.

questions.prompt: Hoe zeg je 'I am learning Dutch'?
questions.explanation: 'Leren' means to learn; 'Ik leer Nederlands' = I am learning Dutch.
It is 'het diploma' (the diploma); 'diploma' is a het-woord.
With 'mijn dochter' (third person singular) 'zitten' becomes 'zit': 'zij zit op de basisschool'.

questions.prompt: Vroeger {{1}} ik naar de middelbare school in Turkije. (gaan, verleden tijd)
questions.explanation: The simple past of 'gaan' is 'ging': 'Vroeger ging ik naar school'.

questions.prompt: Na de basisschool wil hij Nederlands {{1}} op de middelbare school. (leren)
questions.explanation: After the modal verb 'wil', the main verb goes to the end as an infinitive: 'leren'.

questions.prompt: Werk dat je thuis voor school moet maken, heet ________.
questions.explanation: 'Huiswerk' is homework: schoolwork you do at home.

questions.prompt: Na de basisschool ga je naar de ________ school.
questions.explanation: After primary school children go to 'de middelbare school' (secondary school).
